events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Sandpoint
events.description: 1 death. Bonner County. Tree fell on 17 year old male in backyard of home. Several reports of trees downed and tops snapped in the Sandpoint, Dover areas. There was a report of shingles being blown off roof. The BMX track was damaged by downed trees. Wind gusts estimated to be around 65 MPH.

events.title: Hail near Macks Inn
events.description: 2 deaths (indirect). Fremont County. Just before 3 pm a pickup truck crashed into a semi tractor trailer and both individuals in the pickup truck died due to the accident. One individual in the semi was airlifted to a local hospital with injuries. The accident occurred 1 mile south of Macks Inn on US Highway 20. Small hail accumulating to 3 to 4 inches in a 30 minute time frame was believed to be a significant contributing factor in the accident according to Idaho State Police. The Highway was shut down for 4 hours due to the accident.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near (muo)mountain Home A
events.description: 3 deaths. Elmore County. The AWOS at Mountain Home AFB measured a 58 MPH wind gust with several reports of damage received by the public. A dust storm from the gust front of a nearby thunderstorm reduced visibility to near zero, resulting in a 7 car accident with 3 fatalities. Idaho State Police officials reported the accident was on Highway 51, southeast of Mountain Home. ISP officials have determined the dust storm reduced visibility significantly and was the cause of the accident.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Hope
events.description: 1 death. Bonner County. The broadcast media reported that a 21 foot boat with 10 people capsized on Lake Pend Oreille with 1 fatality. There were high waves due to a passing thunderstorm with an estimated 30 mph wind gusts.

events.title: Flood near Sun Vly
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Blaine County. Rain on top of continued snow melt pushed the Big Wood River to flood stage and eventually reaching moderate and major flood stage at Hailey. The entire Big Wood River Valley encountered major flooding with as many as 5,000 evacuations from Bellevue to Hailey to Ketchum and Sun Valley by May 6th. Many people went without electricity in the valley today with water pumps also running continually with major flood damage in basement homes. events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near St Charles
events.description: 4 deaths. Bear Lake County. Winds from a severe thunderstorm of 70 mph or greater caused large waves and capsized a ski boat with 7 people on board on Bear Lake on the Idaho portion of the lake. There were 4 fatalities with 3 survivors from the accident.
